bundesliga.name: Bundesliga
bundesliga.text: Bayern München recorded the biggest margin of the recent Bundesliga results with a 6-1 win over RB Leipzig. There were two draws: Union Berlin and Borussia Dortmund finished 0-0, while Werder Bremen and SC Paderborn 07 played out a 2-2.

champions_league.name: Champions League
champions_league.text: Manchester City's 5-1 win over AEK Athens was the biggest margin across the recent Champions League results, while AS Roma also cruised to a 4-0 victory against Slovan Bratislava. There were draws in Fenerbahce 2-2 Slavia Prague, VfB Stuttgart 1-1 Club Atlético de Madrid, and FC Bayern München 2-2 Arsenal FC.

conference_league.name: Conference League
conference_league.text: The biggest margin of the recent Conference League results was Kairat Almaty's 1-5 defeat to Panathinaikos. There were several draws: AGF 1-1 Egnatia, FC Nordsjælland 2-2 CSKA Sofia, Iberia 1999 1-1 Mjällby AIF, Jablonec 0-0 Brighton & Hove Albion FC, Pafos 1-1 Riga FC, and Red Star Belgrade 2-2 F.C. København.

eredivisie.name: Eredivisie
eredivisie.text: Recent Eredivisie results saw FC Groningen lose 2-5 to Ajax Amsterdam, the biggest margin of the round, while PEC Zwolle beat Go Ahead Eagles 4-1. There were draws as SC Cambuur and AZ Alkmaar finished 2-2, and NEC Nijmegen and Fortuna Sittard also drew 2-2.

europa_league.name: Europa League
europa_league.text: The biggest margin of the recent Europa League results was Lillestrom's 0-6 defeat to Real Sociedad, while Union St.-Gilloise beat Hapoel Be'er 4-0 and Ararat-Armenia lost 0-4 to AZ Alkmaar. Several matches ended level, including Besiktas 2-2 Crystal Palace, Juventus 2-2 Stade Rennais, NK Celje 2-2 RB Salzburg, and Lech Poznan 1-1 Sunderland.

la_liga.name: La Liga
la_liga.text: In recent La Liga action, FC Barcelona and Real Sociedad each recorded 5-2 wins, over Real Betis and Málaga respectively, while Real Madrid beat Sevilla 4-1. The biggest margin was Barcelona's and Real Sociedad's three-goal victories. There were draws between Villarreal and Elche, Valencia and Athletic Club, Getafe and Rayo Vallecano, and Deportivo Alavés and Málaga.

ligue_1.name: Ligue 1
ligue_1.text: Recent Ligue 1 results saw Angers SCO lose 2-5 to Olympique de Marseille, the biggest margin of the round. Lille OSC drew 1-1 with Stade Brestois 29, while Paris FC edged Stade Rennais FC 1901 4-3.

premier_league.name: Premier League
premier_league.text: Brighton & Hove Albion's 5-0 win over Crystal Palace was the biggest margin of the recent Premier League results. Leeds United and Manchester United drew 1-1, as did Ipswich Town and Nottingham Forest. Other results included Manchester City beating Ipswich Town 3-2 and Tottenham Hotspur defeating Coventry City 3-1.

primeira_liga.name: Primeira Liga
primeira_liga.text: Braga lost 1-2 to Gil Vicente, and Vitória de Guimaraes beat Maritimo 5-0. The 5-0 win was the biggest margin, and there were no draws.

serie_a.name: Serie A
serie_a.text: AC Monza's 4-0 win over Cagliari Calcio was the biggest margin of the recent Serie A results. There were no draws across the matches, with AC Milan edging Atalanta BC 3-2 and Torino FC beating AC Monza 3-2.

super_lig.name: Süper Lig
super_lig.text: Recent Süper Lig results saw Kasimpasa beat Samsunspor 4-1, the biggest margin of the listed matches, while Fenerbahce also won 3-0 against Alanyaspor. There were no draws in these results, with other wins including Erzurum BB 2-0 over Eyupspor, Amed SFK 1-0 against Konyaspor, Galatasaray 1-0 at Genclerbirligi, Goztepe 2-1 at Kocaelispor, Istanbul Basaksehir 2-1 over Gaziantep FK, Trabzonspor 2-0 against Besiktas, and Kocaelispor 2-1 at Alanyaspor.
